title: Researchers from Germany and France Visit the AIP Center
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: On October 30, 2026, researchers from Germany and France visited the AIP Center. Researchers in the field of AI from the two countries were visiting Japan to participate in the Trilateral AI Symposium 2026, a joint symposium among Japan, Germany, and France held at the Delegation of the European Union to Japan on October 27 and 28. Taking advantage of this opportunity, they also visited the AIP Center. On the day of the visit, approximately 20 guests were welcomed to the AIP Center in Nihonbashi, Tokyo. Representing the AIP Center, Center Director Masashi Sugiyama, Group Director Tatsuya Harada and Team Director Naoto Yokoya introduced the research activities of the Mathematical Intelligence Group, Physical Intelligence Group and Domain Intelligence Group, respectively. Their presentations were followed by an active and engaging question-and-answer session.
